sourceCorrections.rationale: The two directional cells are the southern and northern parts of Les Bréguières.
The exact north-eastern IRIS is centered on chemin de la Maure; the local place name replaces the bare direction.
The exact north-western IRIS is centered on chemin des Caucours; the local place name replaces the bare direction.
RN7 is the official IGN/INSEE label of this exact local sector. It is retained as an explicitly reviewed place label because no municipal source supports replacing the whole polygon with La Pinède.
